required_properties: separate trust domain from governed runtime
acceptable_target_profiles: separate restricted evidence repository with independent administration
object storage with immutability/WORM and independent credentials
dedicated audit/evidence service with signed or hash-linked records

approved_profiles.scope: CDX reference evidence pipeline / core-release evidence-independence gate

independent_preservation.rule: At least one human-approved custody profile must demonstrate actual independent write/read/verify provenance and the full negative matrix before CDX-BLOCK-EVIDENCE-INDEPENDENCE-001 may close. Implementation alone never satisfies the requirement.
